entry.name: abl.dsp.bitgrunge~
entry.description: A gritty, lo-fi oscillator based on the parity of bits in an incrementing count. The number of set bits in an unsigned int switches from odd to even in a self-similar non-repeating pattern. Subsequent powers of two mean each bit will be switching at half the rate. Generating a square wave oscillator from all the bits XORed together produces many sub-oscillators of the phasor frequency.
